answer: Lock the payout, grade, then compare deltas. Each epoch escrow holds the reward until three jurors independently re-derive the answer; a juror scoring two points off the median files a slash that burns at finality. Read the spread, not the average, because a farm grading its own clones agrees perfectly and shows zero spread. Price the cheapest fake: one pass needs a bond plus three audit slots, a marble copy with no jade or umber provenance behind it, which costs more than doing the work.
